posts.body:
Beginning Tuesday, August 18, for a limited time, Trainers and doughnut lovers alike can experience the new Krispy Kreme Pokémon Doughnut Collection, celebrating 30 years of Pokémon.

Inspired by some of Pokémon’s most beloved characters, this limited-edition collection brings fan-favorite flavors and fun designs to every bite. Meet Pikachu, a lemon-flavored Kreme™ filled doughnut dipped in smooth vanilla icing. Sing along with Jigglypuff, featuring our iconic Original Glazed® doughnut topped with sweet strawberry-flavored buttercreme and strawberry cookie crumble. Turn up the heat with Charmander, an unglazed shell filled with chocolate and toasted marshmallow flavors and finished with rich caramel icing. Complete your collection with Bulbasaur, topped with smooth vanilla icing, Squirtle, filled with cotton candy buttercreme and decorated with colorful sugar toppings, and the classic Poké Ball Doughnut, an Original Glazed® doughnut dipped in vanilla icing, covered in red sprinkles, and finished with chocolate icing. Catch every doughnut before they're gone. This limited-time collection is available only at Krispy Kreme.

Take your tastebuds on vacation with our Destination Dozen! Inspired by desserts from around the world, this collection brings you three craveable new flavors for a sweet summer getaway:

🍮 Tres Leches Inspired Doughnut — Fluffy unglazed doughnut filled with smooth tres leches Kreme™, topped with sweet creme buttercreme, cake doughnut crumbs & a hint of cinnamon.

🌴 Guava Cheesecake Doughnut — Creamy cheesecake Kreme™ meets bright guava filling, finished with glossy guava icing, a sweet drizzle & a light crunch.

🍫 Choco Dulce Cookie Crunch Doughnut — Bold chocolate dulce Cookie Kreme™, chocolate icing, cookie crumbles & a swirl of dulce de leche buttercreme.

Hosting an event? Try our Destination Dessert Specialty Dozen Bundles!

📍 Available in shop, drive thru, online for pickup & delivery from 7/28 – 8/9/2026 at participating U.S. and Canadian shops. Subject to availability. Not offered in Puerto Rico.

Say hello to our newest twist on a classic! The beloved Original Glazed® just got a blueberry-flavored makeover — bursting with sweet blueberry flavor for the perfect finale to National Blueberry Month.
Celebrate with a sweet deal: Buy any dozen (or 16-ct Minis), get a Blueberry Original Glazed® dozen for just $5!
✅ In-shop, drive-thru & online for pickup or delivery
✅ Limit 2 in-shop or drive-thru
✅ Limit 1 online for pickup or delivery
🔑 Use promo code: BLUEBERRY for online orders
📅 Available 7/23/26 – 7/26/26 at participating U.S. and Canadian shops

Offer subject to product availability.

Cue the confetti... and the doughnuts! This Friday, July 17, we're celebrating Krispy Kreme's 89th birthday the sweetest way possible.
For one day only: Get a dozen hot, fresh Original Glazed® doughnuts for just 89¢ when you purchase any dozen at regular price!
✅ Available at participating U.S. shops
✅ Limit 2 dozen for in-shop & drive-thru
✅ Limit 1 dozen for online pickup or delivery
Don't miss this once-a-year deal — swing by Friday and treat yourself (and someone else)!

Cue the confetti... and the doughnuts! Krispy Kreme turns 89 this Friday, July 17 — and you can lock in your celebration dozen starting today!
Pre-order now for just 89¢ on a dozen hot, fresh Original Glazed® doughnuts when you purchase any dozen at regular price.
✅ Available at participating U.S. shops
✅ Limit 2 dozen for in-shop & drive-thru
✅ Limit 1 dozen for online pickup or delivery
📅 Offer valid Friday, July 17 — pre-order today to guarantee yours!
Skip the wait and pre-order now so your birthday doughnuts are ready when you are!

Dad deserves something special, and the Krispy Kreme Father's Day Doughnut Collection delivers just that. At the heart of it is two limited-time doughnuts made inspired by Dad and featuring a variety of classic flavors he'll love:

2 Chocolate Iced Bowties
2 Drizzle Doughnuts
3 Original Glazed®
3 Chocolate Iced Kreme™ Filled
2 Chocolate Iced with Sprinkles

Plus, enjoy $0 Delivery at participating shops from 6/19–6/21! 

Order your Father's Day Dozen today!

Skip the hunt and grab something sweeter this Easter. Krispy Kreme's Easter Basket Collection features three festive doughnuts bursting with springtime color and fun. Available March 24 while supplies last.
